g_t1.rule: |table(y_i) - e_ct_i| <= 1.000000000000e-12 at every unmerged NODE; a merged node reads its site's mean and its miss is half that site's spread

loo.rule: each site removed, the table rebuilt from the rest, the site predicted

g_b3.rule: worst relative |analytic - central difference| at h = 1.000000000000e-5 over 5 atoms x 3 coordinates x 64 nodes <= 1.000000000000e-8

g_c1.rule: |engine e_seam - the runner's own sum| <= 1.000000000000e-10 on every node, the table entering BOTH sides as ONE reading per UNORDERED pair of units, at that pair's own contact

reverse_leak.rule: what serving the OTHER direction as well would have added, i.e. the double count the serving rule refuses: measured on every node, never argued away

g_b0.rule: THE GATE is the SERVED walk: bounded(q_h, r_min, kT) on the full law with the transfer row the interpolant ITSELF at each walk radius, minimised over every angular geometry a real contact can present (|q| <= 1 - p^2, cos theta_d over its full physical [-1,1]), including the table's own behaviour below its innermost knot. The STRICT leg (the largest knot shape carried inward under exp(-c0 r)), the NEAR leg (the largest shape at or inside r_min_oh, carried the same way) and the LINEAR leg (CT-2's own letter) are walked beside it and none is hidden behind another. If the served walk refuses, the DECLARED FENCE is walked: the shape read at the innermost knot's separation for every r below it, the prefactor still running -- a stated fence, nothing chosen, nothing fit.
g_b0.served_leg: H–O potential falls to -5.3611e-2 at r = 2.63 bohr, more than kT below its value -5.2315e-2 at its fit floor r_min = 2.781 (walk minimum -5.4336e-2 at 2.48 bohr, 2.2 kT below the floor)
g_b0.served_monotone_walk: H–O potential falls inward at r = 2.95 bohr (-5.1515e-2 < -5.1076e-2)
g_b0.angular_grid_rule: a coarse pass then a fine pass over one coarse cell; a minimum over a grid is an UPPER bound on the true minimum, so the resolution is stated with the depth
g_b0.fenced_leg: H–O potential falls to -5.3611e-2 at r = 2.63 bohr, more than kT below its value -5.2315e-2 at its fit floor r_min = 2.781 (walk minimum -1.1595e-1 at 0.50 bohr, 68.6 kT below the floor); H–O potential is not positive at contact: -1.1595e-1 at 0.5 bohr
g_b0.fenced_monotone_walk: H–O potential falls inward at r = 2.95 bohr (-5.1515e-2 < -5.1076e-2)
g_b0.fence_price: the energy is continuous at r_clamp and dS/dr is not; this is the jump in dE/dr there, on the deepest geometry at that radius
g_b0.strict_leg: H–O potential falls to -7.5717e-2 at r = 2.73 bohr, more than kT below its value -7.3237e-2 at its fit floor r_min = 2.781 (walk minimum -6.9029e-1 at 0.50 bohr, 665.0 kT below the floor); H–O potential is not positive at contact: -6.9029e-1 at 0.5 bohr
g_b0.monotone_walk: H–O potential falls inward at r = 2.95 bohr (-6.5481e-2 < -6.3373e-2)

plant_i.rule: one knot moved by its own tolerance moves the served value there by exactly that

plant_ii.rule: P -> -P through SeamPlant::FlipChargeTransfer moves the engine's seam energy by 2*|table|

argmin_seam.rule: the contact is an argmin over the donor's two hydrogens and jumps where they tie; measured, not asserted small
argmin_seam.at: the donor turned 90.10° about its own oxygen at R_OO = 2.7 Å, the contact passing from atom 0 to atom 1

c1.branch_rule: (a) the line at 2.7/2.9/3.1 A all within AND at least 50 of 64 within; (b) the line within but fewer than that; (c) the clamp leaves the line unserved
c1.remainder_rule: dE_exact - [E_q(g) - E_q(40)]_engine - wall(g) - TABLE(g); the table is EXACT at the knots, so this remainder is the map's own residual and not a fit's
c1.why_here: the served walk on CT-2's contact terms was RUN and REFUSED before this freeze (g_b0.served_leg below): CT-2 clamped its amplitudes against its own transfer row, which is shallower than the table, so the clamp is re-run with the table held

clamp.rule: for each grid exponent pair each class's amplitude is the largest the SERVED walk admits, by bisection on [0, P_ls] to 1.000000000000e-6 relative, the two classes iterated to a fixed point (at most 20 rounds)
clamp.held_inside_the_clamp: FIELD-9's three walls; the transfer row at the table's deepest SERVED reading at each radius; the dispersion at an exact 0, because FIELD-6's rule fits C6 after both contacts

g_b0w.rule: bounded(q_h, r_min, kT) on the WHOLE served law - the table plus the re-fit contacts plus the walls plus the charges - returns None. LIQUID-2's admission gate. RUN even though the clamp makes it pass by construction, because a gate that is assumed is not a gate.
g_b0w.monotone_walk: H–O potential falls inward at r = 2.95 bohr (-5.1639e-2 < -5.1245e-2)

held_out.name: twistbent_R2.7_tw20_t85_d0
held_out.s2_band_rule: the re-fit law's own WORST in-sample miss over the sixty-four, taken the TIGHTER of two ways: absolute, and the worst miss as a FRACTION of that node's own |dE_exact| applied to the predicted total. Which is tighter is measured, not assumed.
held_out.s2_comparative_bar_rule: CT-2 S2's own letter max(0.25*|dE_exact|, 5e-4) on the PREDICTED total, replaced by the measured one at read; the programme's two landed forward predictions missed by 10.9 percent (CT-1 S2) and 22.9 percent (CT-2 S2)
held_out.s2_branch_rule: (a) inside the TIGHTER of band and comparative bar; (b) inside the looser only; (c) neither
